metadata.description: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at Vicenzaoro September 2026. Find event dates, opening hours, registration and natural-diamond sourcing information.

announcement: Vicenzaoro September 2026 · 4–8 September · Fiera di Vicenza · Meet Uniglo Diamonds

hero.title: Vicenzaoro September 2026: Meet Uniglo Diamonds
hero.lead: Uniglo Diamonds is preparing to meet international buyers and present natural diamonds selected around different retail, wholesale, manufacturing and jewellery-design requirements.
hero.para1: Vicenzaoro September 2026 will take place from 4–8 September 2026 at Fiera di Vicenza in Vicenza, Italy. The international B2B exhibition brings jewellery brands, retailers, manufacturers, wholesalers, diamond suppliers and other industry professionals together ahead of the important year-end buying season.
hero.para2: Visitors can explore potential additions to their diamond inventories, discuss detailed sourcing specifications and begin conversations about long-term supply relationships supported by Uniglo's Antwerp diamond expertise.

eventDetails.note: Event information was last checked on 21 August 2026. Visitors should confirm their badges, travel arrangements and final programme updates with the event organiser before travelling.

whatIs.title: What Is Vicenzaoro September?
whatIs.para1: Vicenzaoro is an international business-to-business exhibition covering the gold, jewellery and watch supply chain. Its September edition is particularly relevant to businesses preparing collections, stock and sourcing strategies for the final retail months of the year.
whatIs.para2: The exhibition brings together more than 1,300 exhibitors and professionals from 145 countries. Visitors can compare suppliers, preview upcoming collections, examine diamonds, gemstones, materials and finished products, attend industry discussions and meet potential business partners in person.
whatIs.para3: Unlike a consumer jewellery fair, Vicenzaoro is designed primarily for commercial activity. Retailers can assess products for their stores, manufacturers can investigate components and technology, designers can source diamonds and other materials, and distributors can identify suppliers suited to their respective markets.
whatIs.para4: For diamond buyers, the exhibition provides an opportunity to compare stones, discuss specifications and assess potential suppliers within one international sourcing environment.
whatIs.imageAlt: Vicenzaoro September 2026 exhibition at Fiera di Vicenza

whatCanBuyers.title: What Can Buyers Source at Vicenzaoro September 2026?
whatCanBuyers.intro: Vicenzaoro divides the exhibition into communities representing different parts of the jewellery and watch industry. The principal exhibition areas cover:
whatCanBuyers.outro: For diamond buyers, jewellery manufacturers and retailers, the exhibition provides an opportunity to compare products across different suppliers while examining quality, shape, measurements, commercial suitability and potential supply arrangements in person.

whySeptember.title: Why the September Edition Matters to Diamond Buyers
whySeptember.para1: September is an important sourcing period for retailers preparing for proposals, weddings, Christmas gifting, New Year celebrations and other year-end purchasing occasions. Decisions made during this period can influence which products appear in showcases during some of the busiest retail months.
whySeptember.para2: Effective diamond assortment planning involves more than purchasing whichever shapes or grades are currently attracting attention. Buyers must consider local customer preferences, practical price points, repeatability, replenishment possibilities and the balance between core inventory and more distinctive diamonds.
whySeptember.para3: Manufacturers may also be preparing production schedules for year-end jewellery collections. Securing suitable diamonds early can reduce the risk of delays caused by unavailable sizes, inconsistent measurements or late specification changes.
whySeptember.discussLabel: Vicenzaoro September allows buyers to discuss matters such as:

meet.title: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at Vicenzaoro September 2026
meet.para1: Uniglo Diamonds will present natural diamonds for retailers, wholesalers, manufacturers, designers and jewellery businesses seeking experienced sourcing support.
meet.para2: The available portfolio spans different carat weights, colours, clarities, measurements and cutting styles. Buyers can discuss Round Brilliant diamonds alongside popular fancy shapes such as Oval, Emerald, Pear, Princess, Cushion, Radiant, Marquise, Heart and Asscher.
meet.para3: Different businesses often require very different diamond assortments. One retailer may need diamonds for a core bridal range, while another may be searching for a particular centre stone for an individual client. A manufacturer may require consistent specifications across a production run. A wholesaler may need commercially relevant diamonds for several regional customers, while a bespoke jeweller may need an individual diamond selected around a highly specific request.
meet.para4: Meeting the Uniglo Diamonds team allows buyers to explain these requirements directly and examine sourcing possibilities based on their intended products, markets and customers.
meet.imageAlt: Natural diamonds presented by Uniglo Diamonds at Vicenzaoro

naturalDiamonds.eyebrow: Natural Diamonds for Real Business Needs
naturalDiamonds.title: Natural Diamonds Selected Around Real Business Requirements
naturalDiamonds.para1: Diamond sourcing should begin with the purpose of the stone rather than an isolated grade on a report. A diamond intended for a solitaire engagement ring may be evaluated differently from diamonds selected for earrings, an eternity band or a tennis bracelet.
naturalDiamonds.para2: Matching, dimensions, proportions, face-up appearance, availability and replacement consistency can all affect whether a diamond or group of diamonds is commercially suitable.
discussItems: Matching requirements for earrings and multi-stone jewellery
Diamonds for bridal and engagement collections
Repeat supply for established jewellery designs

shapes.title: Natural Diamond Shapes for Different Markets
shapes.para1: Diamond-shape preferences vary across countries, retailers and customer groups. Round Brilliant diamonds remain essential for engagement rings, solitaire jewellery, diamond earrings, tennis jewellery and other classic designs. Their familiar outline and strong brilliance make them relevant across many different markets.
shapes.para2: Oval, Pear and Marquise diamonds offer elongated proportions and can create greater visual coverage. Emerald and Asscher-cut diamonds provide a more architectural appearance defined by broad flashes of light and step-cut faceting.
shapes.para3: Cushion and Radiant diamonds combine distinctive outlines with strong brilliance, while Princess-cut diamonds remain relevant for square designs and geometric jewellery. Heart-shaped diamonds may be selected for romantic, gifting or highly personalised pieces.
shapes.para4: Rather than presenting every shape as suitable for every market, Uniglo Diamonds works to understand how a stone will be positioned, set and sold. This helps buyers select diamonds that make sense for their actual customers and jewellery collections.

measurements.title: Diamond Measurements, Proportions and Appearance
measurements.para1: Carat weight is important, but it does not provide a complete picture of a polished diamond. Two diamonds with the same carat weight can have different measurements, proportions and face-up appearances. This is particularly relevant for fancy-shaped diamonds, where length-to-width ratio and outline can significantly influence the stone's character.
measurements.para2: A jewellery manufacturer may require precise measurements to fit an existing mounting. A retailer may prefer an Oval or Emerald diamond with a particular length-to-width ratio. A designer may need stones with proportions that support a distinctive visual direction.
measurements.considerLabel: Before meeting Uniglo Diamonds, buyers should consider whether their requirements include:
considerItems: Specific length, width or depth measurements
Existing mountings that must be accommodated
Matching requirements for more than one stone
Visual characteristics that cannot be defined by grade alone

bridal.title: Diamonds for Bridal and Engagement Jewellery
bridal.para1: Bridal jewellery remains one of the most important commercial applications for polished diamonds. A bridal retailer may require documented centre stones across several popular carat weights and quality combinations. A manufacturer may need centre diamonds and matching side stones for repeatable engagement-ring designs. Bespoke jewellers may instead require individual diamonds selected around a client's precise preferences.
bridal.discussLabel: Buyers can discuss natural diamonds for:
bridal.para2: A strong bridal inventory often includes both dependable core options and distinctive diamonds for customers seeking something more individual. Buyers should consider which shapes, sizes and price positions are currently missing from their ranges before attending the exhibition.

matching.title: Matching and Calibration for Jewellery Manufacturing
matching.para1: Matching is particularly important when several diamonds will be used within the same piece of jewellery. Diamond earrings, three-stone rings, eternity bands, tennis bracelets, tennis necklaces and other multi-stone designs require consistency across relevant characteristics. Measurements, shape, colour, clarity and overall visual appearance may all need to be coordinated.
matching.para2: For manufacturers, consistent calibration can also improve setting efficiency and repeatability. Stones that vary significantly in size or proportion may require adjustments during production and can result in an uneven finished appearance.
matching.discussLabel: Buyers meeting Uniglo Diamonds can discuss requirements for:
matching.imageAlt: Matched and calibrated natural diamonds from Uniglo Diamonds

certification.title: Certification and Documentation Requirements
certification.para1: Documentation requirements can vary according to the diamond's size, value, intended market and customer expectations. Some buyers require individual grading reports for centre stones. Others may need commercial documentation appropriate to calibrated or smaller diamonds.
certification.considerLabel: Before the meeting, buyers should identify:
considerItems: Whether individual grading reports are required
Information needed for internal inventory systems
Whether documentation must accompany each diamond
Requirements for parcels, pairs or layouts
certification.para2: Discussing documentation at the beginning of the sourcing process helps avoid misunderstandings after a diamond selection has been prepared.

antwerp.title: Antwerp-Based Diamond Expertise
antwerp.para1: Antwerp has been one of the world's most established diamond-trading centres for generations. Uniglo Diamonds' Antwerp background provides the business with a strong connection to the international diamond trade and an understanding of different market requirements.
antwerp.para2: However, a successful supplier relationship depends on more than location. Buyers also require accurate communication, clearly defined specifications, realistic delivery expectations and consistent follow-up.
antwerp.para3: Uniglo Diamonds approaches sourcing by first understanding what the buyer is trying to manufacture, stock or sell. This helps the team assess which shapes, qualities, measurements and supply arrangements may be most relevant.
antwerp.para4: The approach can support a retailer sourcing engagement-ring centre stones, a manufacturer preparing a repeat collection, a wholesaler serving several markets or a designer developing a specialised diamond-led range.

prepare.title: How to Prepare for a Meeting with Uniglo Diamonds
prepare.para: Vicenzaoro is a large exhibition, and buyers can make better use of their time by arriving with a clear sourcing brief. Before meeting the Uniglo Diamonds team, consider preparing:
items: The diamond categories you want to source
Intended retail or wholesale price position
Questions about repeat supply and future availability
prepare.note: A detailed brief does not prevent buyers from discovering new possibilities. It creates a useful starting point and allows the discussion to focus on diamonds that are commercially relevant to the buyer's business.

communities.title: Vicenzaoro's Nine Jewellery Communities
communities.intro: The exhibition's nine communities organise suppliers according to their principal products and areas of expertise.

items.title: CREATION Mountings & Semi-Finished
items.body: Components used to construct finished jewellery.

items.title: ESSENCE Gems, Diamonds, Corals & Pearls
items.body: Suppliers of diamonds and other precious materials. One of the most relevant communities for diamond buyers.

items.title: Delivery at Palakiss
items.body: Cash-and-carry environment for jewellery and components available for more immediate purchasing.

communities.note: Diamond buyers should review the official exhibitor catalogue and hall map before arriving because relevant suppliers and related manufacturing businesses may be located in different exhibition areas.

registration.title: Registration and Admission
registration.para1: Vicenzaoro September is reserved for jewellery-industry operators. Registration is mandatory, and admission is free for qualified professionals.
registration.para2: Retailers, wholesalers, suppliers, private-label businesses, agencies, journalists and other recognised jewellery professionals may register through the official Vicenzaoro platform. Visitors should complete their registration and download their badges before travelling.
registration.para3: The organiser may request professional or business information during the registration process. Visitors should carry valid identification and the documents or confirmation associated with their badges.
registration.para4: Minors may enter only when accompanied by an adult and subject to the organiser's visitor regulations.

concurrent.title: T.Gold and VO Vintage
concurrent.tgoldPara: T.Gold focuses on machinery and technology for the jewellery and goldsmith industries. It is relevant to manufacturers and businesses interested in production equipment, processing, innovation and manufacturing efficiency. Diamond buyers working closely with manufacturers may also find T.Gold useful for understanding how production technology is influencing diamond setting, jewellery construction and manufacturing capacity.
concurrent.vintagePara: VO Vintage is dedicated to vintage watches and jewellery. Unlike the main Vicenzaoro B2B exhibition, VO Vintage is also open to collectors and members of the public according to its separate admission arrangements. Visitors should check the relevant registration requirements if they intend to attend more than one event.

getting.title: Getting to Fiera di Vicenza
getting.para1: Fiera di Vicenza is located at Via dell'Oreficeria 16, 36100 Vicenza, Italy. The venue is near the Vicenza Ovest exit of the A4 motorway and can be reached from Vicenza railway station using local transport or event shuttle services when available.
getting.para2: Vicenza is situated on the Milan–Venice railway line. Verona and Venice are among the principal airports used by international visitors.
getting.para3: The organiser publishes travel, parking and shuttle information for the exhibition. Travellers should check the latest schedules before departure and allow additional time during busy exhibition days.

partnerships.title: Building Partnerships Beyond the Exhibition
partnerships.para1: The value of a trade exhibition is not limited to the diamonds viewed during a single meeting. The most useful outcomes often begin with an accurate understanding of the buyer's business and continue through future sourcing conversations.
partnerships.para2: Uniglo Diamonds approaches Vicenzaoro as an opportunity to reconnect with established partners, understand how different markets are changing and introduce its diamond-sourcing capabilities to new businesses.
partnerships.nextStepsLabel: After the meeting, buyers may wish to:
nextSteps: Request a more focused diamond selection
Prepare a matched pair or multi-stone layout

items.question: When is Vicenzaoro September 2026?
items.answer: Vicenzaoro September 2026 will take place from Friday 4 September to Tuesday 8 September 2026.

items.question: Where is Vicenzaoro September 2026 being held?
items.answer: The exhibition will be held at Fiera di Vicenza, Via dell'Oreficeria 16, 36100 Vicenza, Italy.

items.question: What are the Vicenzaoro September 2026 opening hours?
items.answer: The exhibition is open from 10:00 to 18:30 from Friday through Monday. It closes at 17:00 on Tuesday 8 September.

items.question: Is Vicenzaoro open to the public?
items.answer: The main Vicenzaoro exhibition is reserved for jewellery-industry professionals. VO Vintage has separate arrangements and is open to collectors and members of the public.

items.question: Is admission to Vicenzaoro free?
items.answer: Admission is free for qualified jewellery-industry professionals, but registration is mandatory.

items.question: How do I register for Vicenzaoro September 2026?
items.answer: Visitors must register through Vicenzaoro's official registration platform and obtain their event badges before entering the exhibition.

items.question: What products can buyers find at Vicenzaoro?
items.answer: Buyers can explore high-end and contemporary jewellery, goldsmith production, natural diamonds, gemstones, pearls, watches, components, packaging, visual merchandising, machinery and jewellery technology.

items.question: Will Uniglo Diamonds be at Vicenzaoro September 2026?
items.answer: Uniglo Diamonds is preparing to meet buyers at Vicenzaoro September 2026 and present its natural-diamond sourcing capabilities. Visitors should confirm the final stand location before travelling.

items.question: What is Uniglo Diamonds' stand number at Vicenzaoro September 2026?
items.answer: The September 2026 stand number has not yet been confirmed for publication. This page will be updated as soon as the official location becomes available.

items.question: What natural diamonds can buyers discuss with Uniglo Diamonds?
items.answer: Buyers can discuss natural diamonds across different carat weights, colours, clarities, measurements and shapes, including Round, Oval, Emerald, Pear, Princess, Cushion, Radiant, Marquise, Heart and Asscher.

items.question: Can buyers discuss matched and calibrated diamonds?
items.answer: Yes. Buyers can discuss matched pairs, calibrated diamonds, coordinated side stones, eternity-band layouts, tennis-jewellery layouts and other multi-stone requirements.

items.question: Can Uniglo Diamonds support bridal jewellery requirements?
items.answer: Buyers can discuss centre stones, side stones and calibrated diamonds for engagement rings, wedding bands, eternity rings and other bridal jewellery applications.

items.question: Can manufacturers discuss repeat-supply requirements?
items.answer: Yes. Manufacturers should provide their required measurements, quality ranges, quantities and expected production schedules when discussing repeat supply.

items.question: Can buyers book a meeting with Uniglo Diamonds before Vicenzaoro?
items.answer: Yes. Booking in advance is recommended for buyers who want dedicated time to discuss particular diamonds, specifications or sourcing requirements.

items.question: What is T.Gold?
items.answer: T.Gold is the concurrent exhibition dedicated to machinery and technology for the jewellery and goldsmith industries. It runs from 4–8 September 2026.

items.question: What is VO Vintage?
items.answer: VO Vintage is a dedicated event for vintage watches and jewellery. It will take place from 4–7 September 2026 and has separate public-access arrangements.

finalCta.title: Meet Uniglo Diamonds in Vicenza
finalCta.para: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at Vicenzaoro September 2026 to explore natural diamonds and Antwerp-based sourcing possibilities developed around the requirements of your business. Whether you are preparing a new bridal range, refreshing a diamond inventory, sourcing stones for jewellery manufacturing or looking for a dependable long-term supplier, the Uniglo Diamonds team looks forward to discussing your requirements in Vicenza.
